- [ ] **Do:** on Android, open Chronicle's map and raise its sheet to half, tap Navigate, pull up the ready bar, tap "What I’m into ›", then press the system Back; go back to Chronicle. **Expect:** Back pops the page alone, the ready bar still raised; Chronicle's sheet is still at half: its Back handler waits for focus (`SheetFrame`, what-im-into-page audit 1).

- [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone and on Android, set the largest accessibility text size, open What I'm into's page and scroll it slowly. **Expect:** each heading's category and kind lines sit whole in the heading's fixed height (`intoHeadingH`, `lineHeight` 22 and 20 at the font scale), none clipped; "Art" has no blank band above it at rest (what-im-into-page audit 12).

- [ ] **Do:** on a 320 pt-wide phone (an iPhone SE of the first generation, or Android at 320 dp) at the default text size, switch subtypes against their defaults until a kind's line reaches its longest named form ("Plaques and small memorials off"). **Expect:** the line stays one line in SF and in Roboto; `OFF_LINE_MAX` (31) was measured in Chromium's font only (what-im-into-page audit 7).

- [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone, on an exploring walk, open What I'm into's page from the drawer, then tap a reminder's notification so the walk beneath would present its viewer (a Modal) while the page is up. **Expect:** nothing is presented from the unfocused walk under the card; the viewer opens once Back returns to the walk (`whileFocused`, what-im-into-page audit 9).

- [ ] **Do:** on Android with TalkBack, on an exploring walk, pull up the drawer, tap "What I’m into ›" and focus Back; then press the system Back. **Expect:** Back is the route's own arrow (`into-back`), read "Walk, back"; the system Back still pops the page. On an iPhone with VoiceOver the native back button reads "Walk, Back button" (`intoHeader`, what-im-into-page audit 8).
